data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 1/3, CRITICAL): Config dependency — review_telemetry.lambda_role_arn and review_telemetry.bucket_name_prefix are NOT yet in dso-config.conf (only aws_account_id=820258254566 exists). Sibling story 1612 (aws-setup-lambda.sh) writes iam_role_name + lambda_function_name + endpoint_url — NOT lambda_role_arn. RESOLUTION (path b from gap analyst): task-2 ensure_policy MUST exit 6 with stderr message naming missing key 'review_telemetry.lambda_role_arn' if absent — DO NOT silently construct an invalid policy with empty Principal. Add AC: ensure_policy fail-fast on missing config — Verify: stub config returns empty for lambda_role_arn; script exits 6 with stderr containing 'lambda_role_arn'. Also: ensure_bucket fail-fast on missing bucket_name_prefix (exit 6 with stderr naming the missing key). Future: amend story 1612 to also write lambda_role_arn alongside iam_role_name.
